context.roleEssence: This role builds and operates the backend systems underpinning Veridian's AI Platform - the connectors, indexing, and agent infrastructure that Knowledge Hub, AI Assistant, and AI Agents all depend on. At IC4, the work is less about executing assigned tickets and more about leading complex workstreams independently, making sound architectural calls under reliability and security constraints, and mentoring less senior engineers on the team. Success depends on deep familiarity with the platform's data flows and governance boundaries, plus tight collaboration with the immediate team and cross-functional partners who build on top of this infrastructure.

onboardingNeeds.title: Understand the AI Platform's system architecture and data flows
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence centers on building/operating backend infrastructure that multiple products depend on - a senior engineer can't lead workstreams or make sound architectural calls without first understanding how connectors, indexing, and agents actually fit together.

onboardingNeeds.title: Review the codebase and current workstreams for AI Platform
onboardingNeeds.rationale: Directly follows from roleEssence's emphasis on leading complex workstreams independently at IC4 - this is the concrete, hands-on grounding needed before taking ownership of any of them.

onboardingNeeds.title: Learn governance and security constraints affecting AI Platform's data handling
onboardingNeeds.rationale: roleEssence notes the role operates under reliability and security constraints, and the platform underlies a Governance product (permissions, audit, compliance) - a senior backend engineer must internalize these boundaries before shipping changes that touch shared infrastructure.

onboardingNeeds.title: Shadow a senior teammate on an active AI Platform workstream
onboardingNeeds.rationale: Before leading workstreams solo, observing how an established team member navigates the platform's architecture, review norms, and on-call/reliability practices gives IC4-level context that documentation alone won't.
